voice.shows: A desk microphone with a mesh grille; the hold-to-talk key on its base is the accent.

console.shows: A monitor showing the Console, conversation list and chat, with a keyboard; the orb HUD on the screen is the accent.

memory.card: A memory you can search. Also: A memory you control.
memory.shows: An index-card box with its lid tipped back and dividers; the card drawn up out of it is the accent.

coding.shows: An open laptop with code beside a timeline of checkpoints; the checkpoint to rewind to is the accent.

automation.shows: A twin-bell alarm clock facing you; its hands are the accent.

integrations.shows: A dock with two modules seated and a third lifted over its contacts; the lifted module is the accent.

security.card: Local by design, honest about the edges
security.shows: A keep with four round towers, crenellations and arrow slits: Fortress, the default mode; its closed gate is the accent.

gentle.shows: A plump tufted cushion with a feather resting on it; the feather is the accent.

private.card: Locked down by default. Also: Private by default.
private.shows: A small house with its door shut and the curtains drawn; the curtains are the accent.

honest-about-limits.shows: A spirit level ruled along its top; its bubble is the accent.

human-in-the-loop.shows: A person at the centre of a round track with Uru's small box, shut, on the track; the person is the accent.

on-your-side.card: On your side. Also: Yours, and only yours.
on-your-side.shows: A person and Uru's small square box side by side under one umbrella, which the person holds over them both; the umbrella is the accent.

open-to-inspection.card: Open to inspection. Also: Built in the open.
open-to-inspection.shows: An open book, its pages ruled; the ribbon run out over its edge is the accent.

uru.card: Uru (the product card, the cross-link band)
uru.shows: Uru, under wraps: a small square box, its lid lifted a crack, and Uru's two dome eyes peeking out of the dark gap, nothing between them; a round seal with the rune on its side (96px and up). The eyes are the accent.

soft-presence.shows: A cairn of three smooth pebbles; the top pebble is the accent.

tests.shows: A multimeter with leads and probes; the selector knob is the accent.

install.shows: An opened box with its flaps folded out, its contents lifting free; the contents are the accent.

research.card: Where we are. Also: the "In development" status.
research.shows: A banding wheel on the bench with a round tin on it, its lid on and a paper band sealing it (96px and up), and a pencil laid by; the sealed tin is the accent.

follow.card: Follow along. Also: Come along for the build.
follow.shows: A mailbox on its post with the flag up; the flag is the accent.
